how: Fill every 'text' with the translation of 'source': the same meaning in natural es, short enough to say aloud in the cue's time, as it is both spoken and shown; keep names and numbers. Optional 'emphasis': words to colour, as in fixes.json. Don't change i, start or end.

cues.source: I think one of the ways to describe it for both Doug and I is that we're hopeful
cues.text: Creo que una forma de describirlo, para Doug y para mí, es que esperamos

cues.source: that future crews on Dragon vehicles headed to NASA space stations
cues.text: que las futuras tripulaciones de las naves Dragon rumbo a estaciones de la NASA

cues.source: aren't cursing our names because we accepted some feature that was complicated
cues.text: no maldigan nuestros nombres por aceptar algo complicado,

cues.source: and hard to train, and in the end,
They're like, yeah, I can't understand.
cues.text: Que no digan: no entiendo nada.

cues.source: I don't even remember why that's so easy,
cues.text: Ni recuerdo por qué es tan fácil,

cues.source: And so that they forget about us,
cues.text: Y que se olviden de nosotros,

cues.source: because they don't have anything to curse our names over.
